purpose: Meshy 6 text-guided 4K PBR premium stylized three-band Foundry store candidate on transform-baked GA-003

style.prompt: Premium stylized real-time game PBR, readable at 41px; clean illustration, not photoreal. Three broad matte bands: deep warm charcoal only in recesses, mid brown-graphite on most chassis, medium kiln-ash greige ceramic on large armor slabs, never pale white. Restrained solid lava-orange non-emissive enamel on inset plates and weapon hardware. Crisp plate-scale blocking, broad 2-5px tonal variation, sparse chunky edge wear. Rough satin, restrained metalness, neutral albedo; body emission black/off. Team-neutral. No text, decals, chrome, gloss, grime, rust, speckle or microdetail.
